bundle.shortDescription: Local account switching for Claude Code and Codex CLI
bundle.longDescription: Fabric Switchboard keeps several Claude Code and Codex CLI accounts on one machine, stores their credentials in the native vault and lets you choose which account handles the next request, launch isolated or managed sessions and watch quota. Source-available under PolyForm Noncommercial or Internal Use; commercial license on request. Part of the PassionCode.ai toolkit.
